props.title: Garner Health for Syracuse City School District

slots.headline: Lower medical spend for SCSD. Same plan, same network.
$4.2 million more for healthcare
slots.body: Your 2025–26 budget added $4.2 million for healthcare, based on plan changes and claim projections from your actuaries.
slots.headline_2: The plan stays as it is
slots.body_2: PPO, PPO 3 and HDHP 2 keep their terms. Garner sits on top as an added benefit.
slots.body_3: Staff keep the Excellus network and the member tools they use today.
slots.body_4: An analysis of your specialty spend shows where it could come down. No cost, no commitment.

slots.headline: Know which doctors in your network do best
slots.body: Garner studies over 60 billion medical records from 320 million patients to find the doctors who diagnose more accurately and get better outcomes. It recommends only doctors already in your network.
slots.headline_2: The easiest way for staff to choose a doctor
slots.body_2: Garner Assistant shows staff the best doctors who are in network, available and near them.
slots.headline_3: Staff get reimbursed when they choose well
slots.body_3: When staff visit one of those doctors, Garner can reimburse their out-of-pocket costs, including copays, office visits, tests and surgeries. Your per-employee fee covers it.

props.heading: 7.4% lower medical spend in year one. No plan changes.
props.intro: Aon compared Garner-eligible employees at multiple employers with a matched control group, 2020 to 2024. The employers kept their networks and plan designs.
